entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: Vast sea of liquid metal on Mirrodin, center of vedalken and Neurok civilization, later corrupted and drained into the Surgical Bay.

entities.name: Vedalken Spires
entities.description: Towering metal islands housing vedalken and Neurok.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: City on a spire, cultural and political center of blue Mirrans.

entities.name: Pool of Knowledge
entities.description: Site of intellectual and mystical significance in Lumengrid.

entities.name: Titan Forge
entities.description: Enormous device within the sea used to construct colossal metallic constructs.

entities.name: Darkslick
entities.description: Corrupted quicksilver mixed with glistening oil that corroded flesh and metal.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Region from which Phyrexian corruption spread.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: Phyrexian agents who built submerged laboratories in the sea.

entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: Fifth sphere of New Phyrexia into which the sea was drained.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Blue-aligned people living on the spires.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: Assistants of the vedalken in the spires and coast.

events.summary: Phyrexian corruption spreads from the Mephidross and the Quicksilver Sea is among the first waters infected, becoming the Darkslick.
events.quote: the waters of the Quicksilver Sea were among the first to be widely infected

events.summary: Progress Engine agents build submerged labs and design biomechanical sea creatures.
events.quote: agents of the Progress Engine constructed submerged laboratories and designed biomechanical sea creatures as part of their grotesque experiments

events.summary: After New Phyrexia's structure is built, the sea is transplanted to the fifth sphere as the Surgical Bay.
events.quote: The Quicksilver Sea was transplanted to the fifth sphere and transformed into the Surgical Bay .

relations.quote: located on the surface of Mirrodin

relations.note: on a spire near the shore
relations.quote: built on one of the larger spires near the sea's shore
Amid the sea itself was the Titan Forge
